dict.string: SmallBiz Workspace doesn't connect to Bluetooth devices. The card-payment software it includes asks for this permission to support card readers.
SmallBiz Workspace uses your calendar to add and update job appointments you create.
SmallBiz Workspace uses your camera to capture job photos on site.
SmallBiz Workspace uses Face ID to unlock the app when App Lock is on.
SmallBiz Workspace uses your location to pin the job site on the map, and to confirm where you take Tap to Pay on iPhone payments, which card networks require.
